rationale: This is a high-severity Safety fix whose safe behavior is to fail closed. The candidate removes the credential root from the sandbox unconditionally and rejects Keychain-backed macOS readiness before AGY or repository-controlled content can start. Focused and downstream tests cover the rejection and non-macOS readiness paths. macOS AGY availability remains intentionally blocked until KOTA has a provider-only broker or invocation-local AGY-only credential store; no owner exception weakens that boundary.
